title: US markets closed — Thanksgiving Day 2028 (a five-Thursday November: the displacement rule the 2027 sibling measured does not reach this configuration)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, re-fetched first-hand by this lane's own initial research 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200 after its 302 — the page needs curl -L — 109,180 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell rather than inherited from the proposal. The grid header is 'Holiday | 2026 | 2027 | 2028'; the Thanksgiving Day row parses as 'Thursday, November 26***' / 'Thursday, November 25***' / 'Thursday, November 23*** ', so 2028 is a FULL closure on Thursday November 23. Footnote *** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving). NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' CORROBORATION AVAILABLE FOR 2028 IS STRICTLY THINNER THAN FOR 2027, AND THAT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER — all three checks were run this session and two came back out of range. (1) Statute and weekday arithmetic, computed not assumed: 5 U.S.C. 6103 (uscode.house.gov, HTTP 200, 170,863 bytes) reads 'Thanksgiving Day, the fourth Thursday in November'; 2028-11-01 is a Wednesday, so November's Thursdays are the 2nd, 9th, 16th, 23rd and 30th and the FOURTH is 2028-11-23. The rule was re-validated against the tape, not merely quoted: computing the fourth Thursday of November for 1970-2026 and looking each date up in ^GSPC daily bars returns 0 of 57 trading days. (2) The OCC expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) carries data for 2025, 2026 and 2027 ONLY — it does NOT yet publish 2028, so the 'Exchange/OCC holiday' hatched flag that independently corroborated 2027-11-25 has no 2028 counterpart to read. (3) SIFMA's US Holiday Recommendations panel (sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule, HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) runs out at 'New Year's Day 2027/2028 — Saturday, January 1, 2028'; it publishes NO 2028 Thanksgiving recommendation, so unlike 2027 there is no sourced fixed-income early close for 2028-11-24 and none is proposed. Filed estimate on the two counts every sibling closure entry documents (thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25, labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07, presidents-day-market-closure-2028-02-21): the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange operator's own hours page (open issue #2552 measures 37 of 37 closure entries stuck at estimate for exactly this reason), and this lane may not self-confirm. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md's rule for an id that existed only as a sibling's proposal. The one proposal it shadows — proposals/thanksgiving-market-closure-2028-11-23.from-presidential-election-2028-11-07.json — was read first and stays where it is; its date argument is reproduced above from first-hand fetches rather than inherited, and its corridor-emptiness claim was re-run and confirmed here (942 tracked entries, canonical plus proposals; nothing within plus or minus 60 days of 2028-11-23 except presidential-election-2028-11-07 at D-16 and fed-board-closure-2028-11-10 at D-13). WHAT THIS ENTRY ADDS BEYOND THE DATE, and why the title says what it does. The sibling thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25 measured and registered a DISPLACEMENT result: the reopening premium every other US closure carries on its first session lands one session late at Thanksgiving, because the first session back is a 3.5-hour Friday by rule. This lane reproduced that result EXACTLY from the same instruments (^GSPC 1970-2025, n=56: session 2 out-moves session 1 in 35 of 56 = 62.5% against 83 of 194 = 42.8% pooled across MLK, Presidents, Memorial and Labor, z = 2.60) and then asked the question the sibling did not: does it transfer to 2028? IT DOES NOT REACH THIS CONFIGURATION. 2028 is a FIVE-THURSDAY November — Thanksgiving is the fourth Thursday but not the last one — which is a mechanical property known 800 days ahead and true in exactly 16 of the 56 years measured (those where Thanksgiving falls on the 22nd or 23rd). In those 16 the ordering runs 8 of 16, EXACTLY a coin flip, and against the same four-Monday-closure baseline that gives z = 0.56; in the complementary 40 four-Thursday years it runs 27 of 40 = 67.5%, z = 2.85. In the 8 years matching 2028's exact date (1972, 1978, 1989, 1995, 2000, 2006, 2017, 2023) the Friday averages 0.451% absolute and the Monday 0.438% — both BELOW the 0.764% November baseline, and the Monday out-moves the Friday in only 3 of 8. WHAT THIS IS AND IS NOT: the direct four-versus-five-Thursday contrast is UNDERPOWERED (17.5pp difference, two-sided permutation p = 0.36 on 200,000 draws) and the seven per-day cells are non-monotone (37.5% to 87.5%), so this is NOT a claim that the effect inverts in 2028. It is a CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADE with a mechanism: the pooled 62.5% is a tendency of the pooled sample, not a per-year expectation, and 2028 sits in the half of the sample that carries none of it. THE 2027 ATTRIBUTION TRAP DOES NOT RECUR. The displaced Monday 2028-11-27 is November's session 18 of 21 with three full sessions behind it, not the penultimate session the 2027 Monday was; and no December 2028 FOMC blackout can be dated, because federalreserve.gov's published calendar (fetched 2026-09-09, HTTP 200) stops at a note that 'A two-day meeting is scheduled for January 25-26, 2028'. So the one Monday in this pair that could be read cleanly is 2028's — and the reading rule that would justify looking is the one that does not reach it. FOR 2028 SPECIFICALLY: Wednesday 2028-11-22 is a full 09:30-16:00 ET session (the NYSE footnote list names exactly three early closes across 2026-2028 — Monday July 3 2028, the day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve 2026 — and no Wednesday-before-Thanksgiving early close in any year); Friday 2028-11-24 closes at 13:00 ET for equities and 13:15 for eligible options, with NO sourced bond-side hour because SIFMA has not published 2028; November 2028 trades 21 NYSE sessions (22 weekdays minus this closure), the top of the 1970-2025 range of 18-21 (mean 20.38). IMPACT low and symbols [] match every sibling closure entry: a closure removes sessions, it does not signal, and a re-grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md this session for holiday|thanksgiving|black friday|half.day|early close|closure|blackout returns ZERO hits in both, so nothing in the house system can fire on this date in either direction. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry. Full ledger: docs/research/events/thanksgiving-market-closure-2028-11-23.md
